title: Enchanted Spectral Spear
description: A single ornate spear is positioned vertically against a dark background. The weapon features a long, dark metallic spearhead with engraved details and hanging chains, a shaft wrapped in red cord and gold braiding, and ethereal white and purple smoke swirling around it.
prompt: A highly detailed vertical fantasy spear centered in the frame, featuring a sharp dark metal spearhead with intricate engravings and dangling metal chains, a wooden shaft wrapped in red cord and golden braiding, surrounded by swirling translucent white and purple ethereal smoke, set against a dark gradient purple to black background with subtle speckles, dramatic lighting, painted in a realistic digital art style.
